youtube_description:
The Tour du Mont Blanc, or TMB for short, is one of the most famous long distance hikes in the world. We are thru hiking this beautiful trail, that runs trough France, Italy and Switzerland, in 11 days in a loop around the Mont Blanc massive. We are starting close to Chamonix Mont Blanc in the town called Les Houches. In this episode we are hiking from Col du Bonhomme all the way to Courmayeur (stage 3 and 4). We are backpacking this trail in the end of June so early in the season of 2022. NO CAMPING, just hut to hut.
